items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: We were, we were, we were always good friends and all that, but we had this battle going on.

ctx.x: Was Jerry Wexler involved with this suit?

Well, Wexler and, and, and, and Ahmet were, were, you know, it was kind of strange, you know. We were, we were, we were always good friends and all that, but we had this battle going on. We'd get on the phone and they'd tell me, you know, this thing is ours. You know, and I said, no, no, it's mine. You know, I mean, we, we, we were talking about it on the phone, you know. And saying, hey, they're not, not as lawyer to lawyer, but as person to person. And, and, and, and, and they said, well, you know, we're going…
So you were students in, in federal court or?

items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: So, you didn't have to tell Ahmed Erdogan, for instance, or Jerry Wexler what to do, or suggest anything. And, of course, I would always, I always suggest the things.

ctx.x: You know. And I don't mean to demean him by that, although it's okay. That, that was what he brought to the room. So, you didn't have to tell Ahmed Erdogan, for instance, or Jerry Wexler what to do, or suggest anything. And, of course, I would always, I always suggest the things. I always tell you, I make a suggestion once and then never repeat it. Because I learned that's the best way to deal with it. But, but they were, they were a great team, incidentally. One of the few where they'd fight like dogs about…
